title: cleanup: delete old Express/Guided components
description: Remove deprecated Express Flow and Guided Discover components that have been replaced by the Progressive Discover workflow. Clean up unused imports, update component exports, and ensure no broken references remain in the codebase.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL remove all deprecated Express and Guided component files
THE SYSTEM SHALL update module exports to remove deleted components

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL identify and remove all Express and Guided related files
THE SYSTEM SHALL verify no broken imports remain

unwanted.condition: IF other components depend on deleted code
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT leave broken imports unresolved

unwanted.condition: IF shared utilities are incorrectly removed
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT delete code used by Progressive Discover
unwanted.because: Only truly unused code should be removed

preconditions: Progressive Discover must be fully implemented and working
No active routes should reference Express or Guided components
Tests for Progressive Discover must be passing
postconditions: All Express and Guided component files are deleted
Build and tests pass without errors

happy: Given Express components exist, when cleanup runs, then all Express files are removed
Given Guided components exist, when cleanup runs, then all Guided files are removed
Given cleanup complete, when build runs, then build succeeds with no errors
error: Given component has remaining references, when cleanup runs, then references are identified before deletion
Given shared utility marked for deletion, when dependency check runs, then utility is preserved
Given import path breaks, when build runs, then clear error message identifies broken import
